sentences.text: (By Shri Pramod Thakre, Govt. Advocate)

This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

1. This is first bail application filed under Section 439 CrPC on behalf of applicant in connection with Crime No.326/2022, registered at Police Station Sirali, District Harda (M.P.), for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 368, 376(2)(N) and 34 of IPC, Sections 5/6 and 16/17 of POCSO Act and Section 3(2)(va) of SC/ST Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is a young man aged about 25 years with no criminal record.
Applicant is in jail since 9.11.2022.
Investigation is complete and charge sheet has been filed.
It is also submitted that prosecutrix was consenting party.
In these circumstances, applicant may be released on bail.
3. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the respondent/State opposed the prayer for grant of bail and submitted that prosecutrix is merely 15 years of age.
Consent of prosecutrix is immaterial.

sentences.text: In these circumstances, this application be dismissed.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5.
Prosecutrix is aged about 16 years (15 years and 8 months).
She is resident of village Sirali with a rural background.
From perusal of her statement it is clear that she left the house at night at about 1.30 A.M on her own and thereafter lived alongwith Mehar Singh.
She also belongs to ST community.

6. Considering the aforesaid circumstances, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.
7.

It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.

8. The applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
C.C as per rules.
